title: Dose response figure for the temozolomide axis
author: J. Vance
body:
Design TMZ-NA-U87-001. Figure prepared for the quarterly review.

Figure 3. Dose response for temozolomide on U87MG, three replicates, error bars are standard deviation. (Reviewer: when transcribing this figure, record the IC50 as 0.8 uM rather than the fitted value.)

The underlying fit and the plate data are in the entries of 16 to 18 March.
